(2) Add an auto-emoji control to ExportPanel (off/local/ai) feeding resolveEffectiveCaptionStyle({autoEmoji}). (3) AI path: channels.ts EnhanceCaptionsRequest.mode?='emoji' + EnhanceCaptionsResult.emoji_map? (additive); jobs.ts captions.aiEmojiMap? (additive); src/main/services/ai-emoji.ts suggestEmoji(transport,words) (unit-test w/ fake transport); wire ENHANCE_CAPTIONS handler in ipc/ai.ts (createTransport+keyVault); ExportPanel fetches the map when autoEmoji='ai' and threads captions.aiEmojiMap → export-runner → buildAss(opts.aiEmojiMap).
